text: The owned EWS wrapper discards QueryPasswordFromUserAndCache's nsresult and returns Ok(password). Accepted shared outgoing code instead preserves the special successful cancellation status and propagates errors; its UI adapter checks that status before reporting Cancelled. This is not an end-to-end cancellation guarantee: accepted JavaScript throws NS_ERROR_ABORT on cancel, despite the IDL's special-success documentation, and the replacement-password failure branch discards a computed ABORT/RETRY match before returning RETRY. An error still propagates before that return. The empty-password branch returns its computed outcome. These are distinct static contracts and phases; no prompt or retry was exercised.
title: Password cancellation status needs separate checks at the producer, wrapper and retry consumer
